deviations: One composition covers seg036 to seg039 so seg038's first frame is exactly seg036's last state; the seg037 presenter range (mp4 frames 969-1253) holds the model and is not a deliverable. The commission band and its labels recede to 40% with 'not all of it moves' 1/48 s before seg038's first frame.
seg036 opens on 20 frames of blank paper (480.042 to W001325 'compute' 480.87) as the plan specifies; the column outline and slip draw in on 'compute'.

Slip title 'The ceiling' is typeset (KIT rule 4: every word typeset) rather than handwritten. The word 'illustrative' is typeset on the slip's title row from W001331 to the cut so the inputs themselves carry it, in addition to the top-left 'ILLUSTRATIVE MODEL · a made-up inn · swap in real inputs' and the foot receipt.

One oxide accent at a time: the dashed slice outlines (column and enlarged header) are steel dashed (kit-route-dashed); only the 'Say 10 points · hypothesis' tag carries oxide, 532.58 to 562.35; the ceiling line is oxide 562.35 to 580.86; the tag again 580.86 to 583.98; the ceiling line from 583.98 to the cut.

Enlarged panel heights are proportional within the panel (remainder, ceiling, 40-room ghost at about 2x, 5-point ghost at 0.5x from the baseline); the panel is not proportional to the column, as the plan's scale rule says.

On W001551 'What's' the commission-on-slice bar, the direct-cost strip and their labels ('18% to 22% on that slice', 'about $16,500 to $20,000', 'minus direct channel cost', '3.5% to 5%', 'low end: one vendor's own figure') clear and the remainder bar replaces them. Reason: the panel could not hold both label sets and the ceiling and ghost lines without overlap. While the direct cost is on screen it always carries 'one vendor's own figure'; 'my assumption' stays on the column's commission band to the cut.
Tag extension on W001636 'hypothesis' adds a second line 'nobody has measured' under 'Say 10 points · hypothesis' (reads as the plan's 'a hypothesis nobody has measured' without repeating the word).

Heading 'Two things move it' sits directly above the panel (Boska 36) rather than inside it; the ghosted Rooms box '40' sits below the slip. On W001631 'The' both ghost ceilings, their labels, the ghost Rooms box and the half-size dashed slice recede to 20%.
Four inputs 'light' on W001646 'four' as a warm card fill behind each box, one per 0.15 s, no oxide.

Fix round 1: Fix round 1 for S10 (A-23 blocking, A-24, A-25, note A-26). Rebuilt so each step replaces the last. Persistent: ILLUSTRATIVE MODEL label and receipt (now from frame 0), the ceiling slip with its four inputs, and '63%: the Cloudbeds figure, worldwide'. Column phase: one caption slot left of the column; 'Room revenue about $920,000' is replaced by 'Rented bookings about $580,000', then by 'Commission 18% to 22%' with 'my assumption from the reported bands' and 'about $105,000 to $130,000 a year'. seg037 holds that state exactly. seg038: on 'Say' the commission caption and band clear and the dashed slice with the oxide 'Say 10 points · hypothesis' tag replaces them; on 'That's' the column recedes to 30% (slice and tag stay full) and the slice lifts into the enlarged panel (hatched dashed header, 'about $92,000 of revenue, if it moved'). Inside the panel one bar carries the argument at 10 px per $1,000 a year and one caption slot shows only the current step: '18% to 22% on that slice' + 'my assumption' + 'about $16,500 to $20,000 a year'; then 'minus direct channel cost' + '3.5% to 5%' + 'low end: one vendor's own figure' while a hatched cost strip sits on the bar; on 'What's left' the strip lifts away, the bar drops to the remainder and the caption becomes 'What's left about $12,000 to $17,000 a year', then 'about $1,000 to $1,400 a month', then 'Ceiling' as the oxide ceiling line draws at the bar's top. A small steel caveat 'after 3.5% to 5% direct cost / low end: one vendor's own figure' stays from 'What's left' to the cut. Sub-label and retainer tag under the line as before. seg039: 'Two things move it' appears on 'Two' and clears when the first ghost moves; on 'doubles' a ghost copy of the ceiling line rises from the solid line to double height with one label '40 rooms: about $2,000 to $2,800 a month' and a dashed ghost '40' in the Rooms box; on 'A five' that label clears and the ghost recedes to 20%; on 'halves' a second ghost drops to half with '5 points: about $500 to $700 a month', cleared on 'The ten'. Hypothesis tag extension, oxide handoffs and the four lit inputs as before. No exact sub-figure appears anywhere on the canvas.

Fix round 1 supersedes these earlier deviations: the 20-frame blank opening (label and receipt now from frame 0, A-26); 'illustrative' typeset on the slip title row (removed, the always-on label carries it); the receded commission band with 'not all of it moves' at seg038 (band and caption now clear on 'Say'); the 'enlarged' label; the heading placement; ghost ceilings drawn in place (now a ghost copy moves from the solid line, which stays).
